meta.name: Live Caption MVP Project Dashboard
meta.subtitle: A local project-management app for the Ava-like captioning MVP
meta.currentMilestone: Day 2: Translation MVP and export polish

targets.name: Stable live-caption MVP
targets.metric: Live captions + persistent transcript in Chrome

targets.name: Private beta readiness
targets.metric: Stable sessions, exports, instructions, basic UX polish

annotations.title: Project bootstrapped
annotations.body: Local app, GitHub repo, Codex workflow, and README setup completed.

annotations.title: Realtime transcription fixed
annotations.body: Changed Realtime URL/session shape and omitted unsupported VAD for gpt-realtime-whisper.

annotations.title: Transcript persistence confirmed
annotations.body: Stopping caption session now keeps the transcript entry visible.

annotations.title: Spanish translation confirmed
annotations.body: Completed transcript entries can display Spanish translations beneath the original text.

pipeline.title: Translation polish
pipeline.description: Ensure copy, TXT, and JSON exports include translations and failures are visible.

pipeline.title: Reliability pass
pipeline.description: Cleaner errors, browser compatibility checks, and basic test checklist.

pipeline.title: Session saving
pipeline.description: Save sessions locally or to a database so transcripts are not lost.

pipeline.title: Desktop overlay
pipeline.description: A floating caption bar for meetings and videos.

pipeline.title: Private beta
pipeline.description: Share with a few users, collect feedback, and decide the product direction.

risks.mitigation: Add clear billing notes, budgets, and a usage warning.
Test Chrome first, then Safari/Edge; document issues.
One small Codex task at a time; max 3 in progress.
Prioritize readability, large fonts, keyboard access, and real user feedback.

tasks.Task: Download and unzip the project kit
tasks.Why it matters: Get the starter app onto your computer before changing anything.
tasks.Done means: Project folder exists on your computer.
tasks.Next action: Download the zip, right-click, and extract it.

tasks.Why it matters: The app cannot run without Node and npm.
tasks.Done means: `node -v` and `npm -v` work in Terminal.
tasks.Next action: Install the LTS version from nodejs.org.

tasks.Why it matters: You need a safe place to view and edit the code.
tasks.Done means: VS Code opens the project folder.
tasks.Next action: Install VS Code and open the folder.

tasks.Why it matters: You need version history before making changes.
tasks.Done means: You can commit the folder to a local repository.
tasks.Next action: Install GitHub Desktop if the command line feels intimidating.

tasks.Why it matters: GitHub will hold your code and project board.
tasks.Done means: You can log into GitHub successfully.
tasks.Next action: Create the account and save the password safely.

tasks.Why it matters: The OpenAI API key must stay private on your computer.
tasks.Done means: `.env` exists and contains `OPENAI_API_KEY=...`.
tasks.Next action: Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and paste your key.

tasks.Why it matters: This downloads the app's dependencies.
tasks.Done means: `node_modules` folder exists and install ends without errors.
tasks.Next action: Open Terminal in the project and run `npm install`.

tasks.Why it matters: Proves the starter app works on your machine.
tasks.Done means: The app opens at localhost and shows the caption UI.
tasks.Next action: Run `npm run dev` and open the local URL.

tasks.Why it matters: Captions cannot work if the browser blocks microphone access.
tasks.Done means: Browser prompts for mic access and accepts it.
tasks.Next action: Click Start captions and allow microphone access.

tasks.Why it matters: You need a habit of recording what happened.
tasks.Done means: A note exists with what worked and what failed.
tasks.Next action: Use the Testing Log section in the tracker.

tasks.Why it matters: Protects the code while the product is early.
tasks.Done means: Repository exists on GitHub.
tasks.Next action: Use GitHub Desktop or GitHub website.

tasks.Why it matters: Creates a restore point before Codex changes anything.
tasks.Done means: Initial commit exists on GitHub.
tasks.Next action: Commit with message: Initial live caption MVP.

tasks.Why it matters: Gives you one place to see all work.
tasks.Done means: Project exists with table and board views.
tasks.Next action: Follow `GITHUB_PROJECT_SETUP.md`.

tasks.Why it matters: Makes tasks sortable by priority, status, due date, and phase.
tasks.Done means: Fields exist: Status, Priority, Phase, Due date, Effort, Owner.
tasks.Next action: Create fields exactly as listed in the guide.

tasks.Why it matters: Makes every new task easier and consistent.
tasks.Done means: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` is committed.
tasks.Next action: Use the included templates or ask Codex to add them.

tasks.Why it matters: Turns the plan into trackable cards.
tasks.Done means: At least 15 issues exist in your repo/project.
tasks.Next action: Use `github_issues_seed.csv` or copy from the guide.

tasks.Why it matters: Groups tasks into weekly goals.
tasks.Done means: Milestones exist for Weeks 1-8.
tasks.Next action: Create milestone titles from the Weekly Plan sheet.

tasks.Why it matters: Stops the project becoming chaotic.
tasks.Done means: Weekly review note exists every Friday.
tasks.Next action: Use the weekly checklist in this kit.

tasks.Why it matters: Beginners need obvious errors when API keys or ports are wrong.
tasks.Done means: Server shows friendly messages for missing env vars and port use.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to improve startup validation.

tasks.Why it matters: Users should know what the app is doing.
tasks.Done means: UI clearly shows idle, connecting, listening, error, stopped.
tasks.Next action: Use state labels in the caption panel.

tasks.Why it matters: Users may have multiple microphones.
tasks.Done means: Dropdown lists available audio input devices.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add media device selection.

tasks.Why it matters: A failed transcription connection should not crash the app.
tasks.Done means: User sees helpful error and can retry.
tasks.Next action: Add error mapping for common failures.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need recovery without refreshing the page.
tasks.Done means: Retry button reconnects after a failed session.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add retry flow.

tasks.Why it matters: User preferences should remain after refresh.
tasks.Done means: Font size and contrast remain after refresh.
tasks.Next action: Save settings in localStorage.

tasks.Why it matters: Downloads should be easy to identify later.
tasks.Done means: Export file name includes date and session title.
tasks.Next action: Update export function file names.

tasks.Why it matters: Logs help debugging without exposing API keys.
tasks.Done means: Logs never print API keys or raw secrets.
tasks.Next action: Review logging statements and redact secrets.

tasks.Why it matters: You need a repeatable way to test before each change.
tasks.Done means: Checklist covers start, stop, mic, captions, export, errors.
tasks.Next action: Use the included QA template.

tasks.Why it matters: Prevents overengineering before you need accounts.
tasks.Done means: Decision recorded: local JSON, SQLite, or Postgres.
tasks.Next action: Start simple unless you need multi-user now.

tasks.Why it matters: Every caption run should have a saved session record.
tasks.Done means: App stores session id, title, created time, language.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add session persistence.

tasks.Why it matters: Captions need structured storage for search and export.
tasks.Done means: Final caption segments are stored with timestamps.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to persist final transcript events.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need to revisit past sessions.
tasks.Done means: History page lists saved sessions and opens transcript.
tasks.Next action: Build simple local history first.

tasks.Why it matters: Exports and history are easier with names.
tasks.Done means: User can type a session title before starting.
tasks.Next action: Add input above Start captions.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need control over saved transcripts.
tasks.Done means: Delete removes a session after confirmation.
tasks.Next action: Add confirmation dialog.

tasks.Why it matters: Saved transcripts become more useful.
tasks.Done means: Search finds sessions containing matching words.
tasks.Next action: Start with client-side search.

tasks.Why it matters: Prevents losing user transcripts during changes.
tasks.Done means: Tests cover create session, add utterance, export, delete.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex for unit tests around storage module.

tasks.Why it matters: Keeps the product focused on real needs.
tasks.Done means: A short principles doc exists.
tasks.Next action: Write 5 rules for readable captions.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need high contrast and comfortable reading options.
tasks.Done means: Presets exist: Default, High contrast, Large print, Dark room.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add theme selector.

tasks.Why it matters: Some users cannot rely on precise mouse movements.
tasks.Done means: Keyboard shortcuts start, stop, copy, enlarge text.
tasks.Next action: Add shortcut help modal.

tasks.Why it matters: Caption line breaks and spacing affect comprehension.
tasks.Done means: Captions use readable line length, line height, and scrolling.
tasks.Next action: Tune CSS and test at large font sizes.

tasks.Why it matters: Jargon and names improve caption usefulness.
tasks.Done means: Vocabulary terms save between sessions.
tasks.Next action: Persist terms locally and send them on session start.

tasks.Why it matters: Catch avoidable keyboard, contrast, and focus problems.
tasks.Done means: Audit checklist has pass/fail notes.
tasks.Next action: Use the QA checklist in the kit.

tasks.Why it matters: Desktop tech choice affects packaging and system audio.
tasks.Done means: Decision logged with reason.
tasks.Next action: Default to Electron for speed if unsure.

tasks.Why it matters: An overlay app needs a desktop wrapper.
tasks.Done means: Desktop shell opens the existing caption UI.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add Electron in a branch.

tasks.Why it matters: This is the key Ava-like desktop experience.
tasks.Done means: Window can float above other apps.
tasks.Next action: Implement always-on-top mode and window controls.

tasks.Why it matters: Captions should not block the user's meeting.
tasks.Done means: Overlay can be compact and readable.
tasks.Next action: Add compact style toggle.

tasks.Why it matters: Capturing meeting audio is harder than microphone captions.
tasks.Done means: Options and limitations are documented.
tasks.Next action: Research Mac and Windows separately.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need quick control during meetings.
tasks.Done means: Hotkeys can show/hide overlay and change font size.
tasks.Next action: Add safe defaults and settings.

tasks.Why it matters: You need a shareable app for testers later.
tasks.Done means: Build command outputs an installable or runnable app.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add desktop build scripts.

tasks.Why it matters: Good bug reports make fixes faster.
tasks.Done means: Bug template captures steps, expected, actual, screenshots.
tasks.Next action: Commit GitHub issue template.

tasks.Why it matters: Prevents accidental UI breakage.
tasks.Done means: Tests cover state changes and transcript export.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add Vitest or Playwright where appropriate.

tasks.Why it matters: Realtime event handling needs regression tests.
tasks.Done means: Tests cover deltas, finals, errors, disconnect cleanup.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to mock OpenAI websocket events.

tasks.Why it matters: Real environments are harder than quiet desk tests.
tasks.Done means: Test note compares quiet vs noisy accuracy.
tasks.Next action: Test with background noise and note problems.

tasks.Why it matters: Long sessions reveal memory and reconnect issues.
tasks.Done means: A 30-minute test completes or logs exact failure.
tasks.Next action: Leave captions running and record outcome.

tasks.Why it matters: You need a go/no-go list before showing people.
tasks.Done means: Checklist covers env, privacy, errors, export, rollback.
tasks.Next action: Use `RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`.

tasks.Why it matters: Deployment depends on cost and backend needs.
tasks.Done means: Decision logged: simple VPS, Render, Fly, Railway, etc.
tasks.Next action: Pick simple and affordable.

tasks.Why it matters: Private deployment lets testers use it without your laptop.
tasks.Done means: A private URL serves the app and backend.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to add deployment config.

tasks.Why it matters: Caption apps handle sensitive speech.
tasks.Done means: Privacy note explains what is collected and stored.
tasks.Next action: Do not make legal claims you cannot support.

tasks.Why it matters: You need structured feedback, not vague opinions.
tasks.Done means: Invitation explains who it is for and what feedback you need.
tasks.Next action: Use the included beta feedback questions.

tasks.Task: Run first private beta with 1 person
tasks.Why it matters: Validates real usage before building more features.
tasks.Done means: You have written feedback from one tester.
tasks.Next action: Watch silently, take notes, avoid explaining too much.

tasks.Why it matters: Prevents chasing every request.
tasks.Done means: Feedback is sorted into Must, Should, Later, Ignore.
tasks.Next action: Use the feedback prioritization table.

tasks.Why it matters: Speaker labels are useful but technically harder.
tasks.Done means: Transcript can show Speaker 1 / Speaker 2 when available.
tasks.Next action: Treat as experimental until quality is proven.

tasks.Why it matters: Translation expands usefulness but adds latency and cost.
tasks.Done means: User can choose one target language for translated transcript.
tasks.Next action: Start with post-session translation first.

tasks.Why it matters: Lets a user type a response and have it spoken aloud.
tasks.Done means: Typed text can be spoken with a selected voice.
tasks.Next action: Use browser speech synthesis for prototype.

tasks.Why it matters: Summaries help after long meetings.
tasks.Done means: A saved session can generate a concise summary.
tasks.Next action: Use transcript text after session ends.

tasks.Why it matters: Avoid building payment features too early.
tasks.Done means: Plan assumptions are documented, not implemented.
tasks.Next action: List free limits and paid features.

tasks.Why it matters: Enterprise claims require serious security work.
tasks.Done means: Backlog exists for SSO, audit logs, retention controls.
tasks.Next action: Do not promise compliance yet.

tasks.Why it matters: A Scribe-like service requires operations, not just code.
tasks.Done means: Workflow sketch exists for human correction console.
tasks.Next action: Keep this as later-stage research.

tasks.Why it matters: Lets users choose target language before a caption session.
tasks.Done means: Translate to dropdown appears and supports Off, Spanish, French, German and more.
tasks.Next action: Test all target languages.

tasks.Why it matters: Provides the first Ava-like multilingual workflow.
tasks.Done means: Spanish translation appears under saved transcript item.
tasks.Next action: Test copy/download outputs.

tasks.Task: Ensure copy and downloads include translations
tasks.Why it matters: Exported transcripts need to preserve multilingual content.
tasks.Done means: Copy transcript, TXT, and JSON all include translation data.
tasks.Next action: Run export tests and polish errors.

tasks.Why it matters: Confirms the language list works beyond Spanish.
tasks.Done means: French, German, Japanese and Arabic each produce usable results.
tasks.Next action: Run four one-sentence tests.
